context.question: Who will win the 2016 US presidential election?
context.setting: Democrat Hillary Clinton faces Republican Donald Trump in the election of 8 November 2016. Most polls favour Clinton. An international astrology conference in Costa Mesa, California, is holding an election forecasting panel.

provenance.work: Los Angeles Times ISAR conference report (October 2016), as quoted in Gizmodo (2016) and Prothom Alo (8 Nov 2016)
provenance.page: Prothom Alo, 'Astrologers predict who is going to win White House race', published 08 Nov 2016, 14:24
